title: Bilingual (English + Tamil) labels across Local Skilled Workers, Worker Registration, and Worker Search Results

requirements.summary: Add bilingual two-line rendering for Local Skilled Workers group headings and subcategory tiles (English first, Tamil second when TN selected) across the app, including Home page grid.
acceptanceCriteria: On the Home page, each Local Skilled Workers group heading is shown bilingually (English line + Tamil line) instead of English-only (e.g., 'Construction Related' plus a Tamil translation below it).
On the Home page, each Local Skilled Workers subcategory tile shows a two-line bilingual label (English line + Tamil line) instead of a single combined string like 'Door Maker (Kathavu seibavar)'.
All bilingual rendering uses the existing i18n system (I18nProvider + BilingualText) so English is always shown and Tamil appears as the regional line when Tamil Nadu (TN) is selected.

file_operations.description: Refactor Local Skilled Workers group/subcategory configuration to keep the existing English strings as the canonical values (for navigation/search compatibility) while adding stable i18n key references for group names and subcategory names (and removing any mixed bilingual-in-one-string labels like parenthesized transliterations).

Render Local Skilled Workers group headings and subcategory tile labels using the existing BilingualText component with strings sourced from I18nProvider (English always shown; regional line shown when TN selected). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add a small helper for producing display-ready bilingual label pairs (en/regional) for known Local Skilled Workers group/subcategory values by mapping English canonical strings to i18n keys, ensuring the underlying values used for navigation remain the existing English strings.

requirements.summary: Bilingualize Worker Registration page UI (titles, field labels, placeholders, errors, buttons) and show bilingual category/subcategory option labels while submitting existing English values.
acceptanceCriteria: The Worker Registration page header, helper text, each field label (e.g., Full Name, Phone Number, Category, Sub Category, Area / Location, Experience, Working Hours, Photo, Additional Comments), placeholders, and submit button text are displayed bilingually (English first line, Tamil second line) when TN is selected.
Validation errors (e.g., 'Name is required', 'Phone number must be 10 digits', 'Category is required') are displayed bilingually (English + Tamil) and do not introduce runtime errors.
Category and subcategory dropdown option display text is bilingual (English + Tamil), while the selected value submitted to the backend remains the existing English category/subcategory string.

file_operations.description: Replace hardcoded UI strings with i18n keys and render labels/placeholders/buttons/errors using the existing BilingualText component; keep form submission values unchanged (existing English category/subcategory strings), while rendering Select option content bilingually. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Extend helper(s) to return bilingual display labels for category/subcategory dropdown options (including Local Skilled Workers items), while preserving the underlying SelectItem value as the existing English string.

requirements.summary: Bilingualize Worker Search Results page UI (title, filters, buttons, states, filter chips) and show bilingual category/subcategory option labels while keeping internal filter values English.
acceptanceCriteria: The Worker Search Results page title ('Find Workers'), filter placeholders (area, category, subcategory), buttons ('Search', 'Clear Filters'), loading text, error text, empty state text, and filter chip prefixes ('Area:', 'Category:', 'Subcategory:') display bilingually (English first line + Tamil second line) when TN is selected.

Category/Subcategory dropdown option display text is bilingual (English + Tamil), while the internal values used for filtering remain the existing English category/subcategory strings coming from taxonomy.
No changes introduce new crashes; the page continues to render safely even if taxonomy data is loading or incomplete.

file_operations.description: Integrate I18nProvider + BilingualText to render bilingual page title, filter labels/placeholders, buttons, loading/error/empty states, and active filter chips; render Select option content bilingually without changing the actual filter values (keep existing English strings). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Reuse/extend bilingual label helper(s) for category/subcategory option display in search filters and for chip prefix label selection via i18n keys.

requirements.summary: Extend the i18n translation dictionary with keys required for new bilingual labels across Home (Local Skilled Workers UI), Worker Registration, and Worker Search Results.
acceptanceCriteria: All newly bilingualized UI strings are sourced from i18n keys (not hardcoded English-only strings).
For each new key, English and Tamil translations are present; missing keys fall back safely without breaking UI (consistent with existing I18nProvider fallback behavior).

file_operations.description: Add translation entries (English + Tamil at minimum) for: Local Skilled Workers group names and subcategory names; Worker Registration titles/helper text/field labels/placeholders/buttons/validation messages; Worker Search Results title/filter placeholders/buttons/loading/error/empty-state text/filter-chip prefixes. Ensure fallback behavior remains unchanged and safe.
